headline: Bring your squad into {{The Phantom Pain}}. Up to {{16 players}}.
summary: Joint Operations adds online multiplayer to the single-player game. One player hosts. Up to 15 friends join. Everyone shares the same open world, the same missions and the same Mother Base.
It's free, it's open source, and it never touches Konami's servers.
how: The host's game runs the missions, the enemies and the world. There is one version of events, so everyone sees the same thing.
Every client controls their own character and camera. Your moves go to the host, and the world comes back to you.
No ports to open, no extra accounts and no Konami servers. A direct connection is there as a backup.
